title: Comseed
tagline: Community owned profile website that fosters sharing of knowledge
description: This project allows a community to share one profile and submit posts under that profile with their own wallet address. Users are free to submit any type of content that fits the contentURI metadata standards. They can also encrypt their data and allow certain type of users to decrypt it.
how_its_made: This project involves coding up a custom smart contract that interacts with the Lens Protocol to offer the functionalities of a community shared profile. A subgraph is used to index custom smart contract events and Lit Protocol is used to encrypt and decrypt data while maintaining decentralisation.
